*plant (night)*

**BASIL**  <sub>`town_thesis.gd:125:29`</sub>
> Notes stacked. Chalk lined up. Diagrams pinned STRAIGHT. Nothing left to fuss with.

**BASIL**  <sub>`town_thesis.gd:126:29`</sub>

**KITTY**  <sub>`town_thesis.gd:137:29`</sub>

**BASIL**  <sub>`town_thesis.gd:138:29`</sub>

**KITTY**  <sub>`town_thesis.gd:139:29`</sub>

**BASIL**  <sub>`town_thesis.gd:140:29`</sub>

> Front row, center. I'll shut the workshop early. The whooping is PREPARED.

**BASIL**  <sub>`town_thesis.gd:142:29`</sub>

**KITTY**  <sub>`town_thesis.gd:143:29`</sub>

Then the cut: the south gate at night — the knapsack, one look back at the town, the goodbye he owes nobody, and he walks out of the story.
